GBR.text: The Security Council requests the Secretary-General to report annually on climate-related security risks, drawing on expertise across the United Nations system.
GBR.reason: This gives effect to the United Kingdom’s call for comprehensive UN reporting on the links between climate and security and recognizes the Security Council’s role alongside the wider UN system.

IND.text: Reporting on climate action should continue through the inclusive UN climate process, with attention to implementation of the Glasgow Climate Pact and fulfilment of commitments on climate finance and technology transfer.
IND.reason: India supports reporting through the established process in which all developing countries participate and sees no basis for a separate Security Council report linking climate change and security.

FRA.text: The Security Council requests the Secretary-General to report annually on how climate change affects international peace and security in situations on the Council’s agenda, with analysis tailored to each region and issue.
FRA.reason: Regular, case-specific reporting would help the Council assess and address climate-related security risks in the situations it already considers.
